title: ProductPrd:EnterprisePayroll

_meta.purpose: Enterprise Payroll PRD: KR-first payroll close, payee classes, statutory taxes/4대보험, year-end settlement, payroll-to-accounting bridge, and production close evidence for group entities.

identity.ops_surface: managed through OpenTofu-owned infrastructure, root Makefile bootstrap/install/plan/apply targets, and oya ops surfaces; no manual SSH troubleshooting path

user_decisions: 2026-05-16:D-13 one PRD per suite plus per-app sub-PRDs
2026-05-16:D-15 canonical PRD form is JSON-with-pointers at specs/products/<id>.json
2026-05-16:enterprise scope starts with HR, Payroll, Accounting and remains extensible for every business SaaS module
2026-05-16:deployment must be OpenTofu + Makefile + oya ops; no manual SSH troubleshooting
2026-05-16:shell-script operations must move to Rust where logic exists

target_users.interface: approval queue, team dashboard, exception handling
admin console, imports, policies, close workflow
legal hold, audit evidence, statutory filing and control evidence

acceptance_criteria.given: a KR payroll run is created
acceptance_criteria.then: each payee has legal_entity_id, payee_class, rulepack_effective_date, wage ledger, and evidence digest

acceptance_criteria.given: a group tenant has multiple legal entities
acceptance_criteria.then: each entity closes independently before group rollup and detachment history remains immutable/redacted
export hashes, receipts or rejection reasons, and rollback/repair plan are attached before promotion
balanced GL journal vouchers are produced with source payroll digest and approval evidence

acceptance_criteria.given: a production close canary or evidence gate fails
acceptance_criteria.then: close promotion stops, rollback/quarantine evidence is emitted, and repair routes through hotfix PR or OpenTofu/ops convergence

GA: paid KR group client production close

out_of_scope.item: direct statutory agency submission without credentials/certification
out_of_scope.why: regulator credentials and XSD certification remain external readiness gates
payments adapter is a separate product integration after evidence-safe close
KR entity-kind semantics route owner income outside payroll

invariants: sole proprietor owner is not payroll employee

optimization_practices.implementation: tenant_id + legal_entity_id + region route every transactional write; group rollups are projections, not shared mutable ledgers
Workflow queues expose SLA and exception budgets before operator inboxes overload
payroll, accounting, compliance, and incident workflows emit immutable evidence paths before promotion/resume

packs.notes: Korea-first HR/payroll/accounting fidelity: Labor Standards Act, 4대보험, HomeTax, K-GAAP/K-IFRS, PIPA, ISMS-P, SAPA, rules-of-employment and labor-management-council thresholds.
US expansion keeps payroll tax, benefits, FMLA/ADA/EEOC, GAAP, SOX-style controls, and multi-state employer obligations behind jurisdiction rulepacks.
EU expansion covers GDPR, works-council/local labor overlays, VAT, statutory accounting exports, and data-residency policy.

industry_patterns_adopted.pattern: explicit pay cycle types: weekly, biweekly, semimonthly, monthly, quarterly
industry_patterns_adopted.source: ADP, Gusto — pay cycle type is a first-class entity driving close schedule and tax accrual
industry_patterns_adopted.implementation: PayrollRun includes pay_cycle_type enum (weekly/biweekly/semimonthly/monthly/quarterly); KR default is monthly; US biweekly/semimonthly supported via US rulepack

industry_patterns_adopted.pattern: off-cycle payroll run for bonuses, terminations, corrections
industry_patterns_adopted.source: ADP pay-anyone-anytime, Rippling off-cycle — off-cycle runs are routine, not exceptional
industry_patterns_adopted.implementation: PayrollRun includes run_type enum (regular/off_cycle/correction/bonus/termination); off-cycle run inherits same evidence gate as regular

industry_patterns_adopted.source: ADP Workforce Now — wage garnishments (child support, tax levy, creditor) are a statutory requirement in US/KR
industry_patterns_adopted.implementation: GarnishmentOrder entity per payee; deduction engine applies garnishment before net pay calculation with legal priority ordering

industry_patterns_adopted.source: Gusto, Deel — contractor payments are payroll-adjacent and require distinct tax treatment
industry_patterns_adopted.implementation: payee_class includes contractor; KR 기타소득 and 사업소득 tax treatment routed via KR rulepack; US 1099-NEC via US rulepack

industry_patterns_adopted.source: ADP, WEHAGO — year-end settlement is a mandatory statutory deliverable
industry_patterns_adopted.implementation: YearEndSettlement entity per payee per legal_entity; KR 연말정산 export hash required before settlement close promotion

industry_patterns_adopted.pattern: retroactive pay adjustment with compensating wage entry
industry_patterns_adopted.source: ADP, Workday — retroactive adjustments are common for rate changes, reclassifications, corrections
industry_patterns_adopted.implementation: RetroAdjustment entity produces compensating WageLedgerEntry; audit evidence links original and correcting entries

industry_patterns_adopted.pattern: benefits deduction sync from HR benefits enrollment
industry_patterns_adopted.source: ADP, Gusto — benefits elections drive payroll deductions automatically
industry_patterns_adopted.implementation: BenefitsDeductionSync consumes enterprise.hr.benefits_enrollment.v1; deduction lines injected into PayrollRun before trial close

industry_patterns_adopted.pattern: disbursement method tracking: direct deposit, paper check, digital wallet
industry_patterns_adopted.source: ADP, Gusto — disbursement method is payee preference stored per pay cycle
industry_patterns_adopted.implementation: DisbursementMethod entity per payee; payments adapter consumes enterprise.payroll.disbursement.v1 after close approval

anti_patterns_avoided.source_warning: ADP legacy batch: payroll auto-finalizes without human review gate if no exceptions flag
anti_patterns_avoided.mitigation: trial close required before production close; evidence digest required at every promotion gate

anti_patterns_avoided.source_warning: some SME payroll systems allow direct edit of computed pay lines, breaking audit trail
anti_patterns_avoided.mitigation: WageLedgerEntry is append-only; corrections use compensating entries with source reference

anti_patterns_avoided.source_warning: KR sole proprietor (개인사업자) owner income is not payroll; confusing the two causes 원천징수 errors
anti_patterns_avoided.mitigation: payee_class enum explicitly excludes sole_proprietor_owner from employee class; routed via separate income treatment

anti_patterns_avoided.anti_pattern: group-level payroll close before all entity closes succeed
anti_patterns_avoided.source_warning: shared group close date creates pressure to promote incomplete entities
anti_patterns_avoided.mitigation: group rollup only proceeds after all constituent entity closes emit evidence digests

anti_patterns_avoided.anti_pattern: direct statutory agency submission without hash evidence
anti_patterns_avoided.source_warning: submitting HomeTax/4대보험 XML without storing hash and receipt creates unrecoverable audit gaps
anti_patterns_avoided.mitigation: export hash + receipt (or rejection reason) required before statutory submission close promotion

hyperscaler_bar.target: weekly, biweekly, semimonthly, monthly, quarterly cycles all supported; off-cycle run available at any time
KR 4대보험 and 원천징수 variance <= 10 bps at GA; US payroll tax variance <= 5 bps at GA
KR 연말정산 export hash and receipt required before settlement close; 100% coverage
off-cycle and correction runs carry same evidence gate as regular runs; 0 unaudited off-cycle closes
every disbursement method instruction carries payroll run digest; 100% traceability to wage ledger

anti_patterns: manual agency submission as normal flow

scalability.target: EnterprisePayroll supports SME self-serve through conglomerate legal-entity groups without forked code paths

security.target: tenant, legal-entity, payroll, accounting, and evidence data remain RLS/policy isolated; privileged disclosure is audit chained

performance.target: operator hot paths p95 <= 200ms for preview and <= 150ms for GA under representative tenant shape

efficiency.target: unit economics tracked per employee, pay run, journal posting, evidence item, and workflow action

reliability.target: GA availability 99.95%; RPO <= 5m for professional data; rollback evidence emitted before root-cause analysis

user_experience.primary_navigation: suite shell with HR, Payroll, Accounting, approvals, evidence, and admin work queues; personal/work context boundaries inherited from the workspace shell where applicable

decision_log.decision: Machine-readable PRD JSON is canonical; no new Markdown PRD is introduced.
OpenTofu + Makefile + oya ops are the deployment/ops path; manual SSH troubleshooting is explicitly out of scope.
HR, Payroll, and Accounting are the first enterprise children; suite model remains extensible for procurement, compliance, assets, and corporate intelligence.
